ui.title: ECHOES
ui.lede: Play the true missions of the machines NASA left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space.
ui.noWebgl: This game needs 3D graphics (WebGL), which this browser could not start. Try Chrome or Edge.
ui.shelf.count: {n} of {total} mission patches earned. They are saved on this device.
ui.end.title: The end
ui.play.waypoint.flying: Signal flying: {min} minutes, squeezed into {sec} seconds
ui.play.waypoint.bonk: Rock in the way! Plan around it.
ui.play.timing.early: Too early! It is still flying.
ui.play.timing.flicker: Just a flicker. Wait for the dip!
ui.play.resource.empty: Out of power! Wake up and try again.
ui.sky.title: Look up tonight
ui.sky.up: {body} is up right now! Face {dir} and look about {fists} fists above the ground.
ui.sky.upDay: {body} is up in the {dir}, about {fists} fists high, but the Sun is out. Look again after dark.
ui.sky.down: {body} is below the ground right now. It rises at {time}.
ui.sky.signalMin: {km} million km away. A radio message takes {min} minutes to get there.
ui.sky.signalSec: {km} km away. A radio message takes {sec} seconds to get there.
ui.spot.title: Spot the machine
ui.spot.prompt: This is a real photo taken from orbit. Tap where you think the machine is.
ui.spot.miss: Not there. Look for something that does not belong.
ui.spot.help: Here is a hint. Tap inside the ring.
ui.spot.found: You found it! It is really still there.
ui.spot.alt: Orbital photo of the landing site
ui.about.what: An interactive 3D journey by Team Zorvex for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 (Kandy, Sri Lanka). Children play the true missions of machines NASA left on other worlds.
ui.about.sourcesNote: Every line a machine speaks rests on one of these facts, each checked against the linked source.
ui.about.credits: Data and code we build on
ui.about.aiNote: We used an AI coding assistant (Claude, by Anthropic) to help write code and draft text. People on the team checked every fact against the linked sources. The full log is in docs/AI_USAGE.md in our repository.
ui.about.disclaimer: NASA does not endorse this project. NASA imagery and data are used under NASA's media guidelines and credited to their sources.
ui.subtitle: Humanity explored. Humanity departed. History remained.
ui.journey.hint: Point at an explorer, or press Tab.
ui.holo.unverified: Dates are being checked against NASA records.
